title: MCV3 Business Flow Specification v1
description: Schema validation cho business-flow-spec.yaml files. Dat tai: .mc-data/docs/phase3-architecture/business-flows/<flow-id>.yaml. Su dung boi probe P-QD10-business-flow-runtime de chay E2E driver kiem tra luong nghiep vu da duoc dac ta.

flow_id.description: Dinh danh duy nhat cua luong nghiep vu (kebab-case, e.g. quote-to-cash, customs-declaration)

name.description: Ten hien thi cho luong nghiep vu (e.g. Quote-to-Cash Flow)

description.description: Mo ta ngan gon muc dich va ket qua cua luong nghiep vu

flow_type.description: Loai luong nghiep vu — dung de routing probe va reporting

items.description: Module ID tu req-registry.json (e.g. MOD-CRM, MOD-QUOTATION)

modules_involved.description: Danh sach module tham gia vao luong nghiep vu (theo thu tu chay)

prerequisites.description: Dieu kien phai thoa man truoc khi chay flow (e.g. customer must exist, product catalog loaded)

steps.description: Danh sach cac buoc thuc hien theo thu tu — probe chay sequential

expected_invariants.description: Bat bien toan cuc — phai dung xuyen suot va sau khi chay toan bo flow

timeout_minutes.description: Thoi gian timeout tong cong (phut) cho toan bo flow. Probe P-QD10-business-flow-runtime se abort neu vuot qua.

description.description: Mo ta dieu kien (e.g. 'Customer with email test@example.com must exist')

module.description: Module lien quan den dieu kien (optional)

check.description: API endpoint hoac expression de verify dieu kien (e.g. 'GET /api/customers?email=...' returns 200)

setup_if_missing.description: true = probe tu dong tao data neu dieu kien chua thoa man; false = skip flow voi skip reason

id.description: Dinh danh buoc (kebab-case, unique trong flow, e.g. create-lead, submit-quotation)

module.description: Module xu ly buoc nay (phai co trong modules_involved[])

action.description: Hanh dong thuc hien (e.g. create_customer, submit_quotation, confirm_order)

description.description: Mo ta ngan gon buoc nay (optional — giup doc flow de hieu)

oneOf.description: Vai tro thuc hien buoc nay (e.g. sales_rep, customer, system, finance_officer)
Nhieu vai tro duoc phep thuc hien buoc nay

actor.description: Nguoi hoac he thong thuc hien hanh dong nay

api_endpoint.description: API endpoint duoc goi trong buoc nay (e.g. 'POST /api/quotations/submit'). Probe dung de goi truc tiep.

fixture.description: Du lieu test can thiet cho buoc nay (tao moi hoac tham chieu buoc truoc)

assert.description: Danh sach assertions phai pass sau khi thuc hien buoc nay

expected_state_change.description: Thay doi trang thai entity du kien sau buoc nay (cho probe kiem tra state machine)

poll_interval_seconds.description: Khoang thoi gian giua moi lan poll (giay)

wait_for.description: Neu buoc nay async, poll until condition true truoc khi chay buoc tiep theo

cleanup.description: true = probe tu dong xoa entity da tao o buoc nay sau khi flow hoan thanh

skip_if.description: Expression — neu true thi skip buoc nay (e.g. 'steps.create-lead.skipped == true')

entity_type.description: Loai entity can tao (e.g. Customer, Lead, Product, Quotation)

data.description: Key-value pairs cho entity data (co the dung ${step_id.field} de tham chieu output buoc truoc)

reuse_from_step.description: Neu set, tai su dung entity duoc tao o buoc nay thay vi tao moi (e.g. 'create-lead' → lay customer_id tu step do)

cleanup_after_flow.description: true = xoa entity sau khi flow chay xong (de test environment sach)

oneOf.description: Simple string assertion (mô tả cho dev — probe log as expected outcome)

field.description: Dotted path den gia tri can kiem tra (e.g. 'response.status', 'body.quotation.state', 'headers.location')

expected.description: Gia tri mong doi (kieu phu thuoc operator — co the dung ${step_id.field} cho dynamic values)

description.description: Mo ta assertion de bao cao ro rang

severity_on_fail.description: Muc do loi khi assertion fail — probe dung de emit signal tuong ung

entity.description: Entity bi thay doi trang thai (e.g. Quotation, Order)

from.description: Trang thai truoc (optional — kiem tra sau buoc TRUOC do)

to.description: Trang thai mong doi sau buoc nay

state_field.description: Ten field trang thai trong API response (default: 'status')

oneOf.description: Simple string mo ta bat bien (dung cho reporting + documentation)

description.description: Mo ta bat bien theo ngon ngu tu nhien

check.description: Expression hoac API endpoint de verify sau khi flow hoan thanh

severity_on_fail.description: Muc do loi khi bat bien bi vi pham
